description: Gold analytical table containing one row per hospital admission. It summarises patient demographics, hospital length of stay, mortality, care-unit movement, clinical service history, ICU utilisation, diagnoses and procedures. The source data comes from the deidentified MIMIC-IV research dataset, and dates are shifted.

hadm_id.description: Unique hospital admission identifier and grain of this Gold table.

age_at_admission.description: Derived patient age at the time of hospital admission.

age_group.description: Derived age-group category based on age at admission.

admission_date.description: Calendar date of hospital admission derived from admittime.

admission_year.description: Year extracted from the hospital admission date.

admission_month.description: Month number extracted from the hospital admission date.

admission_location.description: Recorded location from which the patient was admitted.

discharge_location.description: Recorded destination or location at hospital discharge.

hospital_los_days.description: Hospital length of stay in days from admission to discharge.

los_band.description: Categorical band derived from hospital length of stay.

mortality_flag.description: Indicates whether the patient died during the hospital admission.

first_careunit.description: First known care unit recorded during the hospital admission.

last_careunit.description: Last known care unit recorded before discharge.

transfer_count.description: Number of recorded transfer events during the hospital admission.

distinct_careunit_count.description: Number of distinct recorded care-unit values associated with the hospital admission.

initial_service.description: First clinical service responsible for the hospital admission.

final_service.description: Final clinical service responsible for the hospital admission.

service_change_count.description: Number of recorded changes in clinical service during the hospital admission.

security_service.description: Service field intended for service-based row-level access control.

icu_flag.description: Indicates whether the hospital admission included at least one ICU stay.

icu_stay_count.description: Number of distinct ICU stays during the hospital admission.

total_icu_los_days.description: Total ICU length of stay in days. Null when one or more ICU stays have incomplete LOS.

icu_los_complete.description: Indicates whether ICU length of stay is complete for all ICU stays associated with the admission.

primary_diagnosis_code.description: Primary ICD diagnosis code associated with the hospital admission.

primary_diagnosis_version.description: ICD version associated with the primary diagnosis code.

primary_diagnosis.description: Description of the primary diagnosis associated with the hospital admission.

diagnosis_count.description: Number of diagnosis records associated with the hospital admission.

procedure_count.description: Number of ICD procedure records associated with the hospital admission.

_gold_timestamp.description: Timestamp recording when the Gold dataset was generated.
